integrity: The displayed proof uses exact spatial numerical-range normalization and all endpoints. Finite numerical tests are only diagnostic, and neither independence nor third-party certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact zero-membership classification for 2 by 2 complex triangular matrices; not the whole numerical range, not general higher-dimensional operator matrices. The Hilbert p=2 direction is classical. The real aligned-diagonal dissipativity threshold is independently published and not claimed novel. Full text of the new motivating preprint could not be inspected, leaving priority risk.
title: Sharp angular zero-inclusion thresholds and inversion asymmetry on complex \(\ell_p^2\)
